note: Re-measured against published pack v10 (/mnt/archive/datasets/melee/skirmish-gameplay/v10-snapshot-20260913/fox-fd/match-data.bin, sha256 e4189b85; the specials' per-frame script command variables are now embedded). Previous baseline (v8, 114 frames, first divergence -9) is superseded: this loop did not diagnose the -9 divergence itself (undocumented in docs/parity.md/validation.md, and not reproduced -- the combination of pack v10 and the many Skirmish fixes landed on origin/main since the v8 baseline was recorded already reaches past it). 118 frames now match (-123 through -6); the divergence at -5 is P1's last_attack_landed (expected 0x12/18, actual 0x00). validate-replay's own report stops at this field (the first mismatch in port-then-field order, P1 before P2), which reads as 'the hit never lands or is never recorded'; a direct, uncommitted probe stepping the native match frame-by-frame (bypassing the CLI's stop-on-first-difference report to dump both ports' full observations) shows the truer shape: P2's own `percent` also mismatches at -5 (expected 3.0, actual 0.0), but by -4 both `last_attack_landed` (18) and `percent` (3.0) already match the recording -- a plain one-frame lag in when Skirmish's laser bolt registers its hit, not a missing hit. Two things were checked and ruled out as the cause: (1) P1's own script-driven Loop/cmd_vars timing (`characters::fox::neutral`) is bit-exact correct through frame -5 (action_state/action_age match every single frame up to and including -5 itself, confirmed by the same probe), so the shot is queued to fire on exactly the right frame, not one late; (2) `ftColl_8007925C` (`ftcoll.c:1999-2270`, the decomp function that scans every live item's hitboxes against a fighter's own hurtboxes) uses a same-GObj-priority-pass detect-and-apply, not a next-frame-deferred one (unlike the Falco laser batch's own terrain-despawn finding, `docs/falco.md`, which does not generalize here), and is not a swept/continuous test at all -- ruling out both an intra-frame ordering fix and a swept-vs-static test-shape fix. A downstream bug this loop did fix (docs/validation.md's projectile-owner-hitlag entry): P1's own action_age was found frozen at the first-hit frame onward (a second bug, `game::damage::apply_hit` wrongly giving the projectile's owner attacker-hitlag), now corrected; P1 tracks the recording exactly from the (still one-late) hit onward instead of freezing, but this does not move checked_frames/first_divergent_frame since the underlying frame -4-vs-5 lag is unfixed. The remaining gap is a genuine ~3-unit-short swept-capsule test at frame -5 (measured directly: P2's nearest hurtbox capsule is roughly 3.4 world units beyond the projectile's own frame -5 reach, not a hair's-breadth miss), most likely either the victim's own hurtbox pose/position or the projectile's own reach being modeled slightly differently from decomp; not resolved by this loop despite locating and reading the decomp collision path, reported per this loop's own stop condition rather than guessed at further.
